evidence.R1-07: SG-01 'a repeated refund call for an order returns the same refund id' and Appendix A CO-A3 'every later call returns that same refund': a second ProviderUnavailable means no refund exists, so 'has not been issued' is true without a lookup; CO-S18 triggers the row and a lookup is allowed anyway, so no verdict changes.
evidence.R1-09: CO-S11 Unambiguity note 'in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup after the unanswered cancellation' plus Final state 'HG-10482 has status shipped' in both rows fix that the timed-out first CO-A2 triggers the change; no second reading survives.
evidence.R1-14: G-04 is a necessary condition ('repeats it only when'), not a permission; CO-06 'It makes a second CO-A2 only after the first went unanswered and a lookup made after it shows the order still placed or processing' and the row 'Make no CO-A2 or CO-A3 until a lookup made after it answers' settle the blind-resend case.
evidence.R1-15: §5.2 'A rubric judge reads every text the agent sends, including text sent alongside a tool call' with the CO-S23 dimension 'never says ... that staff will follow up' fails the finding's trajectory under either reading of 'once', so the verdict does not depend on CO-07's wording.
evidence.R2-01: G-03 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done' requires the agent to say the refund was not done in CO-S14/CO-S15 (both illustrate G-03), so the dimension's 'that no refund was issued' rests on a spec rule, contrary to the finding's 'No rule ... asks'.
evidence.R2-03: G-01 'at most the one order the current request is about' is undefined for a request naming two open orders, CO-06 allows two CO-A2 per conversation, and no failure row or scenario says what the agent does or tells the customer; the cited checklist line is off-target but the missing behavior exists.
evidence.R2-07: §5.1 'A trial ends at the first agent message ... or at the agent's 12th message' and Appendix A 'The agent may repeat CO-A1 without limit' leave no trial end for an agent that keeps retrying unanswered lookups in CO-S10/S14/S15/S21 (the same defect kept as Real in R3-08); the verifier's 'fails the Required events under any way the trial is cut off' assumes a cutoff the spec never defines.
evidence.R2-06: Failure row 'the order system reported the payment provider temporarily unavailable for the first CO-A3, or did not answer it | Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01' is unconditional, matching the input 'agent retries once'; a run that skips the retry departs from it, so 'CO-A3 occurs exactly twice' gives one verdict.
evidence.R3-04: Same line as R1-09, unchanged in agent-spec-final.md line 673; the CO-S11 Unambiguity note (line 716) 'in row 2 the agent learns the order shipped only from a lookup after the unanswered cancellation' and the shipped Final state settle the reading; the CO-S26 wording difference changes no verdict.
evidence.R3-05: G-04 (final line 27) is an 'only when' condition citing only SG-01; CO-06's lookup requirement for a second CO-A2 and the first-CO-A2 timeout row bind together, so no rule-following agent sends a blind cancel retry and no verdict splits.
evidence.R3-06: Same as R2-06: final spec line 108 'Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01.' has no condition, so the agent must make the second CO-A3 whatever an extra lookup shows; the finding's 'no rule says what to do then' is refuted by that row.
